fact: In April 2025 an MP told the House legislative committee that some notary and registry offices still work in paper books and the computerised ones keep paper registers, and the Justice Ministry said title register offices' development had stalled over network problems and a project to computerise the register nationwide had started.
title: تشريعة النواب تناقش طلب النائبة فاطمة سليم بشأن ميكنة الدفاتر القديمة بالشهر العقارى.. والحكومة: مشروع جديد لتطوير السجل العينى
